description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader to oversee all aspects of facility operations, ensuring exceptional patient care and regulatory compliance.

This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the success of a committed team. If you are a proven leader with a passion for long-term care, we encourage you to explore this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Certified Dietary Manager to lead the food service department at a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL. This facility, with a capacity of 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a supportive environment for both residents and staff. Enjoy working in a vibrant location, situated on a main street with abundant shopping nearby, a nice residential neighborhood, and just 15 minutes from the beach. The facility also features two courtyards, providing pleasant outdoor spaces.

In this vital leadership role, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of dietary services, ensuring high-quality meal preparation, nutritional care, and resident satisfaction. This is a full-time position with consistent 8-hour shifts, offering a competitive annual salary.

Join a team committed to excellence and make a significant impact on the daily lives of residents. This is an urgent opening for a professional ready to contribute to a thriving community.
requirements: Proven experience in food service management, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal dietary regulations
Ability to manage staff, plan menus, and oversee kitchen operations
